lines.en: label kaorispring2:
scene nightsky
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer. And no, I will not be allowing her to drag me to karaoke again if that is what she wants to do.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点下 Kaori 的名字，等她接。不，如果她想再拉我去唱卡拉 OK，我是不会答应的。

lines.en: I more or less just want to see how she’s doing in the greater context of being a seemingly half-possessed human who I have now had a gratuitous amount of weird sex with.
lines.zh: 我多半只是想看看她过得怎么样 —— 毕竟她看起来像个被附身了一半的人，而我已经跟她做了太多无谓的怪异性爱。

lines.en: Oh wow. I wonder if this is how everyone feels when they dial {i}my{/i} number?
lines.zh: 哇哦。我在想，别人拨{i}我{/i}号码的时候，是不是也是这种感觉？

lines.en: I’ll have to ask Nodoka or something. She’s no stranger to railing all of the mental fallacies out of me.
lines.zh: 我得去问问 Nodoka 什么的。她早就习惯把我脑子里那些谬误全部操出去了。

lines.en: : Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 再见！

lines.en: : Hey, Kaori. How are you?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Kaori。你怎么样？

lines.en: : My temperature is regular and all of my body parts are in the correct place! It’s an excellent day!
lines.zh: : 我的体温正常，所有身体部位都在正确的位置上！今天是极好的一天！

lines.en: : Are you working right now? Or are you at home?
lines.zh: : 你现在在上班？还是在家？

lines.en: : I am currently teaching Nao-chan how to write exciting stories about large bugs who try to blend in with regular humans!
lines.zh: : 我正在教 Nao 酱写精彩的故事 —— 关于那些试图混进普通人类里的大虫子的故事！

lines.en: : That is an oddly specific thing to teach someone about that I’m sure will prove to be invaluable at some point in her life.
lines.zh: : 这教的东西具体得有点诡异，不过我敢肯定，在她人生的某个时刻会派上大用场。

lines.en: : There is a problem though, Friend. I do not know how to write stories about things like this or I would have done it myself.
lines.zh: : 不过有个问题，朋友。我自己也不知道怎么写这种故事，不然我就自己写了。

lines.en: : Help! You know how to make bad words into good words, yes? What is a better word for “bug?”
lines.zh: : 救命！你知道怎么把不好的词变成好的词，对吧？「bug」有什么更好的说法？

lines.en: : ...Insect?
: The story is now complete! Nao-chan will soon be the next King Stephen!
lines.zh: : 故事完成了！Nao 酱很快就会成为下一个 King Stephen！

lines.en: : And what is he the king of exactly?
lines.zh: : 他具体是什么之王？

lines.en: : Nightmares.
lines.zh: : 噩梦。

lines.en: : A surprisingly tame answer.
lines.zh: : 这答案意外地温和。

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: : Wait — if you’re done teaching Nao, do you want to hang out? I could come over to your place or something?
lines.zh: : 等等 —— 如果你教完 Nao 了，要不要一起玩？我可以去你家之类的？

lines.en: : Please do! I have been eagerly awaiting your next visit now that I know how it feels to mate, but I felt strange about asking you to come do that to me!
lines.zh: : 请务必来！自从我知道交配是什么感觉之后，就一直热切盼着你下次来访，但总觉得主动叫你来对我做那种事怪怪的！

lines.en: : Even now, my face grows hot just thinking about it!
lines.zh: : 就算现在，光是想想我的脸就发烫！

lines.en: : That’s not really why I’m-
lines.zh: : 我其实不是因为这个——

lines.en: : The excitement grows! I will look at you soon! Hi!
lines.zh: : 越来越兴奋了！我很快就能见到你了！嗨！

lines.en: Kaori hangs up before I have the chance to tell her I’m not {i}just{/i} using her as a booty call and that I genuinely do just want to check in on her.
lines.zh: Kaori 没等我说出口就挂了电话 —— 我不是{i}只{/i}把她当炮友，我是真心想看看她过得怎样。

lines.en: But hey, if sex is on the table, I imagine that soon she will be too.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，既然性爱已经摆在桌上了，我想她很快也会躺上去。

lines.en: scene black
I slide my phone back into my pocket and begin to make my way over to Kaori’s place.
lines.zh: 我把手机滑回口袋，开始往 Kaori 家走。

lines.en: So this time, if I’m teleported into another realm with her adopted daughter, at least our main bodies will remain in a safe location for her to supervise and potentially defile.
lines.zh: 所以这一次，如果我和她的养女一起被传送到另一个世界，至少我们的本体还会留在安全的地方，方便她在旁边监督，甚至加以玷污。

lines.en: Those things are essentially interchangeable for me, so I’d say that works out perfectly.
lines.zh: 这两件事对我来说基本可以互换，所以我觉得这安排再完美不过了。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis1
: Friend! Welcome back to my separatement! It has been many minutes, hasn’t it? Do you remember the rules?
lines.zh: : 朋友！欢迎回到我的分隔间！已经过去好几分钟了，对吧？你还记得规矩吗？

lines.en: : The rules of...being in your apartment?
lines.zh: : 待在你家的……规矩？

lines.en: : Correct! Do not feed the chicken or the Nao-chan or the Frog Boy or anything else. And please remember that the bath tub can only fit one person.
lines.zh: : 没错！不要喂鸡、不要喂 Nao 酱、不要喂青蛙男孩，也不要喂别的任何东西。还有请记住，浴缸只能装下一个人。

lines.en: : Do people normally come over here to use your bath?
lines.zh: : 平时会有人专门过来用你的浴缸吗？

lines.en: : Not yet! But I assume it will happen eventually, so I want to make sure I’m prepared and not surprised by any spontaneous bath gatherings.
lines.zh: : 还没有！但我想总有一天会发生的，所以我想提前准备好，免得被突如其来的泡澡聚会吓一跳。

lines.en: : Great. Well, thank you for reminding me of the house rules. And hello, Nao.
lines.zh: : 很好。谢谢你提醒我家规。还有，你好，Nao。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis2
: Nao-chan! Now that your lessons are complete, you may do or play anything you like! Even if it’s that game where there is a sphere that you catch in a basket on a stick!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱！既然课已经上完了，你想做什么、玩什么都可以！哪怕是那个用棍子上的篮子接球的运动也行！

lines.en: : ...Lacrosse?
lines.zh: : ……长曲棍球？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis3
: The cross, yes! And {i}we{/i} will play a different game! Using our human bodies as the sphere and the stick! Forever!
lines.zh: : 就是那个 cross，对！不过{i}我们{/i}要玩另一个游戏！用我们人类的身体当球和棍子！永远地玩！

lines.en: : Forever?
lines.zh: : 永远？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis4
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but I don’t think I’m physically capable of that yet. Thanks for giving me one more reason to keep practicing, though.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但我觉得我现在的体力还做不到。不过谢谢你又给了我一个继续练习的理由。

lines.en: : Yeah, you just stay out of this. Go play lacrosse.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这事你别插手。去玩你的长曲棍球吧。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis5
: What happens now? Where do I go? What do I do? I do not remember how things started last time. I think my mind was erased from all the mating.
lines.zh: : 现在会发生什么？我去哪儿？我该做什么？我不记得上次是怎么开始的。我觉得我的脑子被交配抹掉了。

lines.en: : Step one — get on the bed.
lines.zh: : 第一步 —— 上床。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis6
: I have arrived at the designated mating spot! You may begin!
lines.zh: : 我已抵达指定交配地点！你可以开始了！

lines.en: : Not yet. There’s a step two first.
lines.zh: : 还不行。先有第二步。

lines.en: : Would it not be “step two second?”
lines.zh: : 难道不是「第二步第二」吗？

lines.en: : That...maybe. I don’t know. Either way, step two — you need to learn when the right and wrong time to do this is or you’ll wind up getting one of us in trouble.
lines.zh: : 那……也许是吧。我不知道。总之，第二步 —— 你得学会什么时候适合做这件事、什么时候不适合，否则会让我们其中一个惹上麻烦。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis7
: Did a mistake occur? I thought sex-mating was acceptable in one’s home. This is why I did not ask to sex-mate in the singing room or at the lemon assistance stand despite how much I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 出错了？我以为在自己家里交配是可以的。所以我才没要求在唱歌房或者柠檬援助摊交配，尽管我非常想。

lines.en: : You {i}kind of{/i} asked at the lemonade stand. You’re really thinking about this that much, though?
lines.zh: : 你在柠檬水摊那儿其实{i}算是{/i}问过了。不过你真的这么在意这件事吗？

lines.en: : Should I not do that?
lines.zh: : 我不该在意吗？

lines.en: : I mean...you {i}can.{/i} It’s just kind of weird to see you having urges like this all of a sudden when you’ve been pretty much sexually dormant for as long as I’ve known you.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你{i}可以{/i}。只是突然看到你有这种欲望挺奇怪的，毕竟我认识你这么久，你基本上一直都是性冷淡状态。

lines.en: : What is that? “Sexually dormant?”
lines.zh: : 那是什么？「性冷淡」？

lines.en: : Like...every time you’ve mentioned “mating” in the past, it’s seemed more {i}scientific{/i} than anything.
lines.zh: : 就是……你以前每次提到「交配」，听起来都更像在讲{i}科学{/i}。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis8
: Not true! You have always flustered me and made my legs shake, Sexfriend! I just never understood how good things could feel until I became a cat!
lines.zh: : 才不是！你一直都让我心慌意乱、双腿发软，性朋友！我只是变成猫之后才明白，原来可以这么舒服！

lines.en: : Which is fine. But we’re still not {i}alone{/i} right now. Nao is literally right there.
lines.zh: : 那没问题。但我们现在还是不{i}独处{/i}啊。Nao 就在这儿。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis9
: Oh. Perhaps she does not like the cross?
lines.zh: : 哦。也许她不喜欢那个 cross？

lines.en: : Can we not mate while she is present? We have done it before. In fact, she has been present for 100%% of the times that we have done it. Even the kiss move.
lines.zh: : 她在场的时候就不能交配吗？我们以前也做过啊。事实上，我们做过的每一次，她在场的概率都是 100%%。连接吻那次也是。

lines.en: : But she {i}shouldn’t{/i} be because sex is a private thing between two people. Except for when it’s not.
lines.zh: : 但她{i}不该{/i}在场，因为性爱是两个人的私密事。除了它不是的时候。

lines.en: : Then I declare that it is not! Please begin!
lines.zh: : 那我宣布它不是！请开始吧！

lines.en: : Sure. As soon as she leaves the room.
lines.zh: : 好啊。等她离开房间就开始。

lines.en: : Nao-chan! Leave the room so your mothermom can engage in the sex with Friend! Your turn will come later!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱！离开房间，好让你的妈妈跟朋友做爱！你的机会以后会来的！

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis10
: {i}No.{/i} She doesn’t get a turn. Only you do.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}。没有她的份。只有你有。

lines.en: : That seems very rude to Nao-chan. It is only fair that she gets to experience the same joy that we do, correct?
lines.zh: : 这对 Nao 酱来说太失礼了。让她也体验和我们一样的快乐才公平，不是吗？

lines.en: : Incorrect. She needs to wait a few years until she...{i}develops{/i} more. And this is something you need to accept as her caretaker or you will cause irreparable harm to both her body and mind.
lines.zh: : 不对。她得再等几年，等她……{i}发育{/i}得更成熟。作为她的监护人，这一点你必须接受，否则会给她的身体和心灵都造成无法弥补的伤害。

lines.en: : Oh, stop pretending to be such a {i}good guy.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，别再装{i}好人{/i}了。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis11
: We both know you’d pound that little girl six ways from Sunday. And you’re being handed the opportunity to do just that on a silver platter.
lines.zh: : 我们心里都清楚，你会把那个小女孩翻来覆去地干个遍。而现在有人把机会端到银盘子上递给你了。

lines.en: : What do you gain from saying “no” other than one more chance to fool yourself into believing there’s some sort of conscience left in that little head of yours, Aki-kun?
lines.zh: : 说「不」你能得到什么，Aki 君？不过是又一次机会，骗自己相信你那颗小脑袋里还剩下点良心罢了。

lines.en: : Can you please just...get out of there and stop playing with her head? It’s unfair that {i}one{/i} voice leaves just for {i}you{/i} to start taking over more.
lines.zh: : 你能不能……从里面出来，别再玩弄她的脑子了？{i}一个{/i}声音刚走，{i}你{/i}就开始变本加厉地接管，太不公平了。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis12
: And always when her heart starts racing too. Cool, right?
lines.zh: : 而且每次都是她心跳开始加速的时候。很酷吧？

lines.en: : Sekai-
lines.zh: : Sekai——

lines.en: : {i}Kaori.{/i} My name is Kaori. And even when I’m not the me inside of me, the fundamentals of my beliefs are still the same, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : {i}Kaori{/i}。我叫 Kaori。而且就算住在我里面的不是那个我，我信念的根基还是一样的，Aki 君。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} don’t know it’s wrong for you to fuck little Nao-chan over there. So {i}I{/i} won’t have a problem with it. Now, go on! Get those feet wet. And by “feet” I obviously mean something else.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}可不知道你干那边的小 Nao 酱有什么不对。所以{i}我{/i}不会有意见。来吧！把脚弄湿吧。当然我说的「脚」显然是指别的东西。

lines.en: : Or just screw me like this in front of her. I don’t wanna change back, though. I forgot how good sex feels as someone without any experience.
lines.zh: : 或者就这么当着她的面干我。不过我不想换回去。我忘了作为一个毫无经验的人，性爱能有多舒服。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis13
: It was a mistake coming here at all, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 根本就不该来这儿，对吧？

lines.en: : A {i}mistake?{/i} Or something you secretly {i}hoped{/i} would happen since you know I like to hang out in here now?
lines.zh: : {i}不该来{/i}？还是说，你知道我现在喜欢待在这儿，所以其实暗暗{i}盼着{/i}它发生？

lines.en: : Let’s mate, Aki-kun! Then wash it all down with a little taste of that forbidden fruit over there. Sounds fun, right?
lines.zh: : 我们来交配吧，Aki 君！然后再尝一口那边那个禁果，把一切冲下去。听起来很有趣，对吧？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis14
: Nao, stop drawing and just leave already. You can see what’s happening over here, can’t you?
lines.zh: : Nao，别画了，赶紧出去。你能看见这边在发生什么吧？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis15
: Of {i}course{/i} she can, but she doesn’t {i}care!{/i} She’s not a real girl, so why {i}would{/i} she?
lines.zh: : 她{i}当然{/i}能看见，但她不{i}在乎{/i}！她又不是真正的女孩，为什么要介意？

lines.en: : Just think of her like one of those super {i}impure{/i} fantasies that are always swimming around in your head, Aki-kun. It’s just like masturbation when you think of it like that, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你就把她当成一个一直在你脑子里游来游去的超级{i}龌龊{/i}幻想就行了，Aki 君。这么一想，就跟自慰没什么两样，不是吗？

lines.en: : In fact, didn’t you use that same sort of mindset to justify fucking {i}everyone{/i} when you first woke up here? Why the change of heart now? Do I need to possess {i}you{/i} next?
lines.zh: : 说起来，你刚来这儿的时候，不就是拿这种心态来给自己睡遍{i}所有人{/i}找借口的吗？怎么现在改主意了？要不要我接下来附到{i}你{/i}身上？

lines.en: : I don’t even want to think about that — but the change of heart was due to me {i}learning.{/i} And accepting people as more than just figments of my imagination.
lines.zh: : 那个我连想都不想想 —— 我改主意，是因为我{i}学会{/i}了。学会了接受别人，承认他们不只是我想象出来的幻影。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis16
: Yet, you {i}don’t{/i} accept this girl as that.
lines.zh: : 可你{i}并没有{/i}把那个女孩当成那样的人来接受。

lines.en: : Which means that argument falls flat and is now propped up by little more than some weird sense of morality and righteous obligation that {i}I{/i} definitely didn’t teach you.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，那套说辞站不住脚了，现在撑着它的，不过是一种奇怪的道德感和正义义务感 —— 那绝对不是{i}我{/i}教你的。

lines.en: : Just let go! Have fun! How do you expect to ever fuck the rich girl and her poor friend if you can’t even put it inside of the mute orphan girl? She’s the easiest target possible.
lines.zh: : 放手吧！玩个痛快！你连那个不会说话的孤女都不敢插进去，还指望能睡到那个有钱小姐和她那个穷朋友？她可是最容易下手的目标了。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis17
: Isn’t that right, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 我说得对吧，Nao 酱？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis18
: Ah.
scene kaoriaptwantspenis19
: She’s just feeling a little shy right now.
lines.zh: : 她只是现在有点害羞。

lines.en: : Yeah. Sure she is, {i}Kaori.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。她当然只是害羞，{i}Kaori{/i}。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis20
: I mean it! Just because she hasn’t come around to {i}me{/i} yet doesn’t mean she won’t come around to {i}you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我说真的！她还没对{i}我{/i}敞开心扉，不代表她不会对{i}你{/i}敞开心扉！

lines.en: : I swear, though — if you come over here and start pulling this thing’s clothes off, she’ll be purring before you even know it. Won’t you, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 我发誓 —— 只要你过来把这小东西的衣服脱掉，她在你反应过来之前就会开始发出呼噜声了。对吧，Nao 酱？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis21
: ...Helloooooo? Anyone home?
lines.zh: : ……喂——喂——？有人在吗？

lines.en: : Just leave her alone...she doesn’t need to be pulled into the same pit that {i}we{/i} come from.
lines.zh: : 别去招惹她……她不需要被拽进{i}我们{/i}出身的那个坑里。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis22
: Neither did {i}Kaori{/i} and she seems to be thriving there, doesn’t she? {i}We{/i} were happy too until I was roadkill. So maybe that “pit” isn’t as bad as you think, Aki-kun?
lines.zh: : {i}Kaori{/i} 也不需要，可她看起来在那儿过得挺滋润的，不是吗？在被撞成路尸之前，{i}我们{/i}也很快乐。所以也许那个「坑」没你想的那么糟，Aki 君？

lines.en: : What’s the name of that one girl who can’t seem to move the fuck on again? Mei? Meiko? M...Mayonnaise?
lines.zh: : 那个好像总是走不出来的女孩叫什么来着？Mei？Meiko？M……蛋黄酱？

lines.en: : You know. The one who looks like she crawled out of a gutter. Wears a bell? Kind of a slut? The gross one who shares a dorm with my perfect little girl.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。就是那个看起来像是从水沟里爬出来的。戴个铃铛？有点骚？那个跟我完美的小女孩住同一间宿舍的恶心家伙。

lines.en: : Can’t say I’m a fan of this new seduction tactic. Having the people I care about trash-talked isn’t one of my biggest turn ons.
lines.zh: : 我可不太喜欢这个新的勾引套路。听人在我面前骂我在乎的人，不是最能让我兴奋的事。

lines.en: : Yeah, but a little girl who won’t say no {i}is{/i} and {i}that’s{/i} not working either. So I don’t know {i}what{/i} I’m supposed to do anymore!
lines.zh: : 是啊，可一个不会说不的小女孩能让我兴奋，而{i}那一套{/i}也没用。所以我真不知道自己还能{i}怎么{/i}办了！

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis23
: Would it kill you to just leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别烦我，会死吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Does it have four wheels and top out at 160kmph?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。它有四个轮子、最高时速 160 公里吗？

lines.en: : This {i}was{/i} a mistake. I really shouldn’t come here anymore.
lines.zh: : 来这儿{i}是{/i}个错误。我真的不该再来了。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis24
: Because you-
lines.zh: : 因为你——

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis25
: Did another mistake happen?
lines.zh: : 又出错了？

lines.en: : Kaori-
lines.zh: : Kaori——

lines.en: : The other me came out, yes?
lines.zh: : 另一个我出来了，对吧？

lines.en: : Is she a bad girl? Because she is gone now. And it will be the me on the outside of me that you will do the sex things with.
lines.zh: : 她是个坏女孩吗？因为她现在已经走了。而且接下来跟你做那种事的，会是在我外面的那个我。

lines.en: : {i}Please?...{/i}
: I need you to touch me or more clouds will come. And there are so many of them now that I am having a hard time thinking straight, Friend.
lines.zh: : 我需要你碰我，不然会有更多乌云飘过来。现在乌云已经多到我很难正常思考了，朋友。

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis26
: I think...I am in heat again...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我又发情了……

lines.en: : And the only way I can feel better is for you to touch me and clear my skies once more...
lines.zh: : 而唯一能让我好受一点的办法，就是你碰我，再把我的天空清干净……

lines.en: : I understand that asking for your sexual participation outright is an undesirable trait in a prospective female companion, but I don’t know what else to do anymore...and...
lines.zh: : 我明白，一个有望成为伴侣的女性直接开口求欢是讨人嫌的特质，但我真的不知道还能怎么办了……而且……

lines.en: : And um...
lines.zh: : 而且呃……

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis27
: It feels as if...there is a part of me missing...when you are not inside...
lines.zh: : 感觉就像……你不在我里面的时候……我身上少了点什么……

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis28
: Please...Friend?
lines.zh: : 求你了……朋友？

lines.en: : Can you help me feel better?...
lines.zh: : 你能让我好受一点吗？……

lines.en: scene kaoriaptwantspenis29
I glance over to find the one reason I {i}haven’t{/i} yet still sitting there at the table — nose buried in a notebook full of bugs and other things.
lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼，发现我一直{i}没{/i}动手的唯一原因还坐在桌边 —— 鼻子埋在一本写满虫子和其他东西的笔记本里。

lines.en: And I think to myself, caught in the tailwinds of my savior, that it {i}isn’t{/i} inherently harmful for her to just {i}be{/i} there.
lines.zh: 而我被救世主的顺风推着，心里想着，她就这么{i}待{/i}在那儿，其实本身{i}并没有{/i}什么害处。

lines.en: if tsukasacurious == True:
I’ve done as much with Tsukasa already. And even if I regret it, that didn’t harm {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 我跟 Tsukasa 已经做过同样的事了。就算我后悔，那也没有伤害到{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: So maybe Nao {i}is{/i} a good way to...{i}test{/i} things. Assuming she wants to.
lines.zh: 所以也许 Nao 是个……{i}测试{/i}的好办法。前提是她愿意。

lines.en: Or maybe it’s her vulnerability that makes putting her in this spotlight somehow {i}worse,{/i} regardless of whether she’s “real” or not.
lines.zh: 又或许，正因为她如此脆弱，把她推到这个聚光灯下才显得格外{i}糟糕{/i} —— 不管她到底「真实」与否。

lines.en: else:
But will she really just “be” there, I wonder? Or will her curiosity get the best of her?
lines.zh: 可我真的想知道，她会只是「待」在那儿吗？还是好奇心会占了上风？

lines.en: This has happened once before and she remained on the outside of the world Kaori and I built around one another.
lines.zh: 这种事以前发生过一次，而她始终留在 Kaori 和我为彼此搭建的那个世界之外。

lines.en: I just worry that having her this close might pull her in, willing or not.
lines.zh: 我只是担心，让她靠得这么近，可能会把她卷进来 —— 不管她愿不愿意。

lines.en: : Nao.
lines.zh: : Nao。

lines.en: : You know what’s about to happen...This is your chance to leave.
lines.zh: : 你知道接下来要发生什么……这是你离开的机会。

lines.en: : She doesn’t want to leave yet...She wants to write another story.
lines.zh: : 她还不想走……她想再写一个故事。

lines.en: : So do I — but instead, I’m about to write the same one all over again.
lines.zh: : 我也想 —— 可我却要再把同一个故事重写一遍。

lines.en: : Friend...I can not take it much longer...
lines.zh: : 朋友……我撑不了多久了……

lines.en: : The me inside of me is screaming...{i}begging{/i} to be one with you. And I feel so...{i}warm.{/i} And confused. And...like I...{i}need{/i} you...
lines.zh: : 我里面的那个我在尖叫……{i}乞求{/i}着要和你合为一体。而我感觉好……{i}温暖{/i}。好混乱。还有……好像我……{i}需要{/i}你……

lines.en: : I need you...I {i}need{/i} you...I need you!
lines.zh: : 我需要你……我{i}需要{/i}你……我需要你！

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……
